verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS feedback and support platform, so letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, a do-not-track setting, or any control over usage analytics. The Reports API and the SDK lifecycle methods are unrelated features and do not count as opt-out capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
